Class JobsClient

java.lang.Object
global.thalion.ttio.workbench.jobs.JobsClient
public final class JobsClient extends Object
Job submit + tracking surface.

Cross-language equivalent: Python ttio.workbench.jobs.JobsClient.

SSE long-poll on /v1/jobs/{id}/events is exposed as a callback-driven events(String, Consumer) rather than an async iterator -- Java has no native async-iterator support before Project Loom virtual threads, and the existing TTI-O Java client surfaces (WorkbenchTransportClient) are callback- driven too.

    • events

      public void events(String jobId, Consumer<JobEvent> onEvent)
      Stream GET /v1/jobs/{id}/events: emit each parsed JobEvent to onEvent as it arrives. Blocks the calling thread until the server closes the connection (v1.0 closes on terminal state). Callers wanting non-blocking behaviour should run this on a worker thread.
